segments.name: Biopharmaceutical
segments.description: A biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing antibody-based medicines for patients with severe autoimmune diseases.
segments.evidence: VYVGART and VYVGART HYTRULO is a first-and-only immunoglobulin G (IgG) Fc-antibody fragment that targets the FcRn.

revenueModel.text: The company earns product net sales from sales of its approved medicines, primarily VYVGART, to patients and healthcare providers globally.
revenueModel.evidence: This strong commercial execution resulted in a milestone for the Company, with VYVGART surpassing $1 billion in product net sales in a single quarter for the first time in the third quarter of 2025.
